To raise one's voice or speak loudly and with urgency; to give, a name; to meet in the sense of being called to a meeting; to have an encounter by chance; to read in the sense of calling out words. Edenics: call - with the exchange of the l and r

To be on or over in the sense of the yoke that is placed on the neck of the ox. Alternate Translations: about; above; according to; also; because; by; concerning; in; in addition; over; with; therefore (when followed by the word " SO ")
